positions.sentence: Students must verify the accuracy of AI-generated content before using or submitting it.
All users must review and verify AI output for accuracy before using or sharing it.
Students should critically evaluate and verify AI output for accuracy.
Everyone should review and verify AI output for accuracy before relying on it.
Policies warn that AI output can be inaccurate, fabricated or biased, including fake citations.
Students must not rely on, cite or accept AI output or sources without verifying them.
AI output should not be treated as automatically accurate or relied on without critical scrutiny.
Instructors should teach, remind and discuss with students that AI output can be wrong and must be verified.
Instructors should ask students to evaluate or verify AI output as part of assignments.
Instructors and staff must review and verify the accuracy of AI output they use or produce.
Students must check that sources and references cited by AI exist and are accurate.
Students should treat AI output as a draft or starting point and assume it is wrong unless verified.
AI-generated code must be tested and verified before it is used.
Students must document the steps they took to verify AI output.
Students should be aware that AI can be wrong, biased or make things up.
